_comment_top: NodeCraft dynamic configuration. Every script path is an absolute Unix path on the gateway. Edit any single line to point at a different location — scripts no longer need to live under one shared 'scripts_path' root. The legacy 'scripts_path' is kept as a fallback for any value that doesn't start with '/'.
_comment_cli: ENM CLI helper. Used by almost every step via 'python <cli_py> "cmedit ..."'.
_comment_arne_enroll: Add Node in ENM + enrollment flow scripts.
_comment_sgw: Verify SGw Reachability — multi-ping moshell script (run on LTE/NR nodes).
_comment_lkf: Install LKF (License File) — import / install / status scripts.
_comment_lkf_smrs: Directory ENM SMRS uses to persist per-node license XMLs. Checked for the LKF fast-path (skip import if file already there).
_comment_baseline: Load Baseline Scripts — moshell .mos invoked by the framework. Can live anywhere (different folder than the ENM CLI scripts).
_comment_baseline_files: Reference list of baseline batch files per RAT (informational, not invoked directly by the framework).
_comment_external_alarm: Pre-define External Alarm — moshell template that creates the 8 AlarmPort MOs on the primary BB. LTE primary only.
_comment_bsc: BSC name -> expected broker IP. Used by the GSM SGW check to verify the node's AbisIp bscBrokerIpAddress points at the RIGHT BSC. Edit here when a BSC is added/changed (no rebuild).
_comment_uri: URI Reconfig + SW Level Check — ENM REST endpoints + target UpgradePackage ID. This value is used DIRECTLY (no auto-detect) for both URI Setting and SW Level Check. Edit it to the expected software version.
_comment_cutover: Cut Over. EVERY command below is operator-editable — no rebuild and no app restart needed (this block is re-read at the start of each run). WARNING: unlock.command_template is DESTRUCTIVE — it unlocks live cells on a production network. Validate with dry_run=true first. Placeholders: {mo_type} {cell_dn} {mo_ref} {node}.

cutover._comment_band_groups: band_key -> group. Band keys come from band_detector.LTE_FREQ_BAND_MAP / NR_BAND_LIST_MAP. A band_key not listed here lands in UNMAPPED and is NEVER unlocked by any button.

unlock._comment: SPELLING UNCONFIRMED. One MO per command — never a regex that could match a whole node.

enable_poll._comment: commands is a LIST — add 'st nrcelldu' if NR cells are missing from 'st cell'. row_regex overrides the built-in tolerant parser; it needs named groups mo/adm/op (avail optional).

traffic._comment: SPELLING UNCONFIRMED ('stzrc'). Traffic = the UE column going 0 -> non-zero. If the UE column cannot be located, on_parse_failure=manual_confirm stops for an operator eyeball rather than guessing a number.

cutover._comment_final_verification: PLUGGABLE — add the real post-cutover checks here later, no rebuild. scope: per_node | once. expect_regex empty = informational only (always passes). fail_regex, when matched, forces a fail.
